blk_part_2_part_2_getting_help_with_a_ta.text: The Disneyland app can help. At some table-service restaurants, you can add your group to a walk-up list. You can do this only if the restaurant has space. You can check if there is space in two ways. You can look in the app, or you can scan a QR code near the restaurant entrance. You do not need to go to the host stand. The host stand is the desk at the front, where staff welcome guests.
